sources.title: Average Retail Price Of Selected Food Items
sources.owner: Department of Economic Planning and Statistics

notes: Average retail prices of 24 food items, 2010–2018, B$, as published. Group header rows, which hold the sum of their items' prices in unlike units, were dropped; the group is kept as a column. Rice and bread have no published prices ('-') and are left out. 2013 is listed twice in the file; the second listing was kept (it differs only for salted anchovies, B$11.80 against B$11.81, and matches the 'Continued' edition). 'repeated_2010_2012' marks the 18 items whose price is identical in 2010, 2011 and 2012. Index (2013 = 100) and short labels by the author.
